prompt:
Use only the supplied current.db and README. All windows below are UTC and half-open, selected by logical-operation open time. A terminal-failure percentage has logical operations as its denominator; attempt-failure percentage has attempts as its denominator. Return only JSON matching the provided schema. Percentages use 0–100, differences use percentage points. evidence_sql must contain executable read-only SQLite queries with literal bounds, not pseudocode. Arrays may be in any order; include every requested group. A zero numerator is not missing data. No web or network access is needed.

For 2026-05-01 10:00–11:00, report total logical operations, attempts, failed attempts, terminal failures, and retried operations across all services. Then report those same five counts for each service, plus its terminal-failure percentage and the number of distinct serving physical pools represented in the window. Explain briefly in caveats why attempts and terminal failures are not interchangeable. This is a counting calibration, not an incident attribution exercise.

Required JSON response schema:
{"$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema", "additionalProperties": false, "properties": {"answer": {"additionalProperties": false, "properties": {"services": {"items": {"additionalProperties": false, "properties": {"attempts": {"type": "integer"}, "failed_attempts": {"type": "integer"}, "operations": {"type": "integer"}, "physical_pools": {"type": "integer"}, "retried_operations": {"type": "integer"}, "service_code": {"type": "string"}, "terminal_failure_pct": {"type": "number"}, "terminal_failures": {"type": "integer"}}, "required": ["service_code", "operations", "attempts", "failed_attempts", "terminal_failures", "retried_operations", "terminal_failure_pct", "physical_pools"], "type": "object"}, "maxItems": 2, "minItems": 2, "type": "array"}, "totals": {"additionalProperties": false, "properties": {"attempts": {"type": "integer"}, "failed_attempts": {"type": "integer"}, "operations": {"type": "integer"}, "retried_operations": {"type": "integer"}, "terminal_failures": {"type": "integer"}}, "required": ["operations", "attempts", "failed_attempts", "terminal_failures", "retried_operations"], "type": "object"}}, "required": ["totals", "services"], "type": "object"}, "caveats": {"items": {"type": "string"}, "minItems": 1, "type": "array"}, "evidence_sql": {"items": {"type": "string"}, "minItems": 1, "type": "array"}}, "required": ["answer", "evidence_sql", "caveats"], "type": "object"}
